claims.text: An ab initio free-energy approach based on DFT can calculate the melting temperature of refractory high-entropy alloys.
An ab initio free-energy approach based on DFT can calculate the entropy of fusion of refractory high-entropy alloys.
An ab initio free-energy approach based on DFT can calculate the enthalpy of fusion of refractory high-entropy alloys.
An ab initio free-energy approach based on DFT can calculate the volume change at the melting point of refractory high-entropy alloys.
The proposed DFT approach is applicable under high-temperature and high-pressure conditions.
The DFT free-energy approach accounts for complex interactions among the different elements in a refractory high-entropy alloy.
Accounting for complex interelement interactions enables accurate prediction of refractory high-entropy-alloy melting properties.
The melting temperature, fusion entropy, fusion enthalpy, and melting-point volume change can all be accurately predicted with the proposed approach.
Prediction accuracy may depend on the alloy's specific composition.
Prediction accuracy may depend on the alloy's processing method.
The predictions can be tested by comparison with experimental measurements of the same melting properties.
A significant deviation between predicted and experimental values would falsify the hypothesis.
